pageDescription: Uninstall programs and automatically clean leftover files
emptyStateDescription: Load the list of installed programs to view, search, and uninstall them.
safetyLinkCloud: Link to Kudu Cloud to see AI safety ratings for your programs
safetyTooltipLocked: Link to Kudu Cloud for safety ratings
confirmForceRemoveDescription: This will delete the program's registry entry and clean leftover files. This cannot be undone.
noRecentLaunchBannerTitle: {{count}} program with no launch detected in {{days}}+ days
noRecentLaunchBannerTitlePlural: {{count}} programs with no launch detected in {{days}}+ days
noRecentLaunchBannerDescriptionWithSize: Using ~{{size}} of disk space. Review whether you still need them.
noRecentLaunchBannerDescriptionNoSize: Review whether you still need these programs.
nativeUninstallDescription: Runs each program's own uninstaller, then automatically scans for and cleans leftover files and folders. This does not verify whether other software needs the program.
noLaunchCandidatesFound: No programs with an older detected launch
launchHistoryLimitations: Launch history is incomplete: background use and dependencies may not be detected, and cleanup can clear records. Missing history means usage is unknown. Only uninstall programs you know you no longer need.
sharedComponentNotice: Shared component: other software or devices may need this. Excluded from bulk selection.
sharedComponentBatchExcluded: Shared component: uninstall individually to review the dependency warning
filesystemDependencyWarning: This filesystem component may be used by NAS, network-drive or virtual-drive software even when you never launch it yourself. Removing it can break access to those drives. Continue only if you know nothing needs it.
sharedDependencyWarning: This shared component may be required by other applications or hardware even when you never launch it yourself. Removing it can stop them working. Continue only if you know nothing needs it.
confirmNativeUninstallDescription: This runs the program's native uninstaller, then automatically cleans leftover files. Other software may depend on this program. Only continue if you know you no longer need it.
confirmNativeBatchDescription: This runs each selected program's native uninstaller, then automatically cleans leftover files. Launch history does not prove a program is unnecessary. Only continue if you know you no longer need every selected program.
